text: Sabelt SpA, the Italian seatbelt and racing-seat maker, is owned by the Marsiaj family of Turin: Giorgio Marsiaj holds 61% and the family holding M. Marsiaj & C. holds 10% (Milano Finanza, March 2024).
short: Sabelt is owned by the Marsiaj family: Giorgio Marsiaj 61% plus the family holding's 10%.

source.name: Milano Finanza – I fratelli Giorgio e Pietro Marsiaj (proprietari di Sabelt) separano le holding
source.quote: In M. Marsiaj figurano fra l’altro il 10% di Sabelt (di cui Giorgio ha il 61%)
source.note: Italian; translates as 'M. Marsiaj includes, among others, 10% of Sabelt (of which Giorgio holds 61%)'. Headline calls the brothers 'owners of Sabelt'.
